acceptanceCriteria: A1: DependencyConfidence has complete partial and unknown states with strict wire serialization and stable unknown reason codes
A2: Complete graphs compute affected downstream verification nodes deterministically from changed nodes
A3: Partial graphs retain known affected nodes and escalate only those nodes to the stronger candidate tier while exposing dependency_graph_partial
A4: Unknown or unsafe graph inputs fail closed and never become green or silently skip required verification
A5: Affected verification planning remains separate from policy required truth and does not weaken protected gates or invent authority
A6: Tri-language documentation explains partial dependency confidence and conservative affected verification behavior
goal: Represent dependency confidence explicitly and reduce verification cost only for deterministically affected nodes without weakening governance truth.
intent: Add complete partial and unknown dependency confidence to the verification graph and produce a conservative affected-node plan.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Known affected nodes are escalated while graph uncertainty remains visible and cannot produce green governance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run complete partial unknown and unsafe graph tests with deterministic node and reason assertions.
